description: The file 'Migration.php' defines a migration class for upgrading a specific version (5.1.0) of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to perform database schema changes, data updates, insertions, and localization string management as part of a system migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles system migration tasks for version 5.1.0 of OrangeHRM, including schema updates, localization, permissions, and role configurations.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration actions such as database updates, inserting permissions, modifying schema, and updating language strings.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LangStringHelper for language string operations.

methods.name: getTranslationHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of TranslationHelper for translation operations.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version field of language strings to the specified version.

methods.name: addValidColumnToRequestResetPassword
methods.description: Adds an 'expired' boolean column to the 'ohrm_reset_password' table.

methods.name: insertModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Inserts a default page configuration for a module and user role with specified priority.

methods.name: insertReviewWorkflowStates
methods.description: Inserts predefined review workflow states for admin and supervisor roles.

methods.name: insertSelfReviewWorkflowStates
methods.description: Inserts predefined self-review workflow states for different roles.

methods.name: insertWorkflowState
methods.description: Inserts a single workflow state record into 'ohrm_workflow_state_machine'.

methods.name: insertReviewListScreenForAdminRole
methods.description: Assigns permissions for the review list screen to the Admin role.

methods.name: modifyThemeTable
methods.description: Alters columns and data in the 'ohrm_theme' table to update theme configuration.

methods.name: modifyTrackerLogsUserForeignKey
methods.description: Updates foreign key on 'ohrm_performance_tracker_log' table for 'user_id'.

methods.name: modifyEmployeeTrackerScreenRolePermission
methods.description: Updates user role permissions for the employee performance tracker screen.

methods.name: updateMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Updates the menu configurator class for a specific module and screen URL.

methods.name: updateRecruitmentMenuItems
methods.description: Updates menu items related to recruitment.

methods.name: updatePerformanceMenuItems
methods.description: Updates menu items related to performance management.
